arithmetic: scaled = share * (1000 - reduction) // 1000. If the sum of scaled shares for a dimension is at most the total, fresh = scaled.Otherwise fresh = scaled * total // sum. solo = min(scaled solo cap, fresh). reserve = total - sum(fresh). Use 128-bit intermediates.
